DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_id as "planId", plan_order_id as "planOrderId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", element_id as "elementId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_order_element_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_order_element_values (plan_id, plan_order_id, element_type_id, param_type_id, element_type_param_id, element_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:planId, :planOrderId, :elementTypeId, :paramTypeId, :elementTypeParamId, :elementId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plan_order_element_values SET value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId AND element_id = :elementId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.plan_order_element_values WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId AND element_id = :elementId
